parts.title: AI Search Landscape and Query Intelligence

sections.title: Executive GEO Summary
checks: Overall GEO readiness and evidence coverage
Priority actions for the next 30, 60, and 90 days
Differences between technical readiness and measured visibility

sections.title: Generative Search Visibility Scorecard
checks: Brand appearance rate across tested prompts
Visibility by AI platform, query category, and intent
Competitive share of mentions and citations
Trend comparisons across comparable measurement periods

sections.title: GEO Opportunity and Risk Assessment
checks: High-value queries where competitors appear but the brand does not
Unsupported or incorrect AI-generated claims about the brand
Important pages that lack useful, citable evidence
Expected impact, implementation cost, confidence, and validation plan

sections.title: Generative Search Platform Coverage
checks: Google AI Overviews and AI Mode
ChatGPT search and relevant web-grounded experiences
Microsoft Copilot and Bing generative search
Claude, where applicable to the research methodology
Regional, language, device, and market-specific differences
Platform access limitations, unsupported features, and collection method

sections.title: GEO Query Universe and Prompt Discovery
checks: Informational, commercial, transactional, and navigational intent
Query source, selection method, deduplication, and sampling coverage

sections.title: Query-to-Intent and Journey Mapping
checks: Questions about problems, solutions, categories, and specific brands
Missing prompt clusters and underserved user needs
Priority by business value, query relevance, and competitive opportunity

sections.title: Prompt Benchmark Design and Reproducibility
checks: Standardized prompt set and version history
Run count per prompt and engine
Date, locale, language, and device context
Personalization and session-state controls where possible
Failed, incomplete, blocked, and unobservable runs

sections.title: Brand Mention Analysis
checks: Product, service, and company name recognition
Positive, neutral, negative, and mixed framing
Context of mention and user intent
Correct naming, spelling, and product attribution

sections.title: Brand Recommendation and Shortlist Analysis
checks: Position within ranked or ordered lists, when explicitly present

sections.title: Brand Accuracy and Hallucination Audit
checks: False availability, geographic coverage, or integrations
Unsupported claims about certifications or customers
Severity, recurrence, source traceability, and correction route

sections.title: Brand Sentiment and Narrative Consistency
checks: Sentiment and tone in relevant generated responses
Confidence and limits of automated sentiment classification

sections.title: AI Citation Performance
checks: Citation distribution by domain and page
Citation presence in answer text versus source panels
Citation coverage by intent and prompt cluster
Citations that are missing, inaccessible, or irrelevant

sections.title: Citation Share and Competitive Share of Voice
checks: Brand citation share within the defined benchmark
Share by engine, query cluster, and market
Citation overlap and exclusive citation opportunities
Sample size and uncertainty alongside every comparison

sections.title: Cited-Source and URL Intelligence
checks: Third-party URLs cited for the brand
Pages that rank organically but are not cited in tested responses
Pages cited despite weak or outdated content
Citation freshness and update frequency, when verifiable

sections.title: Citation Gap and Source Opportunity Analysis
checks: Competitor-cited pages missing from the brand's source footprint
Queries where competitors have corroborating references
Relevant authoritative publications and industry sources
Missing original data, research, documentation, or case studies
Topics where the brand lacks a citable primary source
Source opportunities grouped by effort and strategic value
Evidence required to validate each opportunity

sections.title: Source Reliability and Evidence Quality
checks: Author, publisher, and expertise signals where verifiable
Limits of inferring source influence from observed citations

sections.title: Competitor Discovery and Validation
checks: Competitors selected manually by the user

sections.title: Competitor Visibility Benchmark
checks: Visibility by query cluster and engine
Comparable sample sizes and test conditions

sections.title: Competitor Citation and Content Gap Analysis
checks: Competitor pages cited for priority prompts
Topic coverage and content format differences
Unique data and evidence competitors provide
Missing comparison pages and use-case content
Opportunities for original, more useful evidence

sections.title: Competitive Narrative and Differentiation
checks: Reasons AI systems give for recommending competitors
Attributes used to distinguish competing products
Gaps between intended and observed positioning

sections.title: Competitive Displacement Opportunities
checks: Queries where the brand appears but is not cited
Queries where the brand is cited but poorly represented
Queries where competitors are recommended on weak evidence
Pages or sources that could address the gap
Opportunity value, confidence, and validation method

sections.title: Content Extractability and Answer Usability
checks: Whether important facts are directly accessible in page content
Explicit relationships between entities, products, and concepts
Descriptive headings and coherent page structure
Tables, lists, specifications, and comparison information
Important claims buried in images or inaccessible UI
Excessive boilerplate relative to useful information

sections.title: Topical Coverage and Entity Completeness
checks: Core topics, subtopics, and related concepts
Gaps in contextual links between related resources

sections.title: Originality and Information Gain
checks: Specific examples and real-world case studies
Claims that merely repeat existing sources
Opportunities to create genuinely distinctive evidence

sections.title: Factual Support and Claim Verifiability
checks: Citation and reference quality within content
Claims that conflict with other site pages
Missing dates, units, definitions, and context

sections.title: Content Freshness and Maintenance
checks: Last-modified metadata and actual content changes
Time-sensitive prices, features, policies, and statistics
Review cadence based on content risk

sections.title: Content Format and GEO Suitability
checks: Content format suitability for the question being answered

sections.title: Internal Linking and Contextual Discovery
checks: Links connecting related entities and concepts
Links between overview and detailed pages
Orphaned or weakly connected important pages
Internal links to original evidence and supporting documentation

sections.title: Crawlability and Indexability
checks: Differences between discovered, crawlable, and indexed URLs

sections.title: Rendering and Content Accessibility
checks: Content hidden behind interactions or login
Evidence from actual fetches or browser rendering

sections.title: Structured Data and Entity Markup
checks: Product and service structured data, where applicable
Structured data consistency with visible content
Unsupported assumptions about whether markup causes AI citations

sections.title: Entity Identity and Knowledge Consistency
checks: Clear relationships between brand, products, and organization
Consistent contact, location, and company details
Conflicting entity information on the website

sections.title: HTTP, Security, and Technical Reliability
checks: Infrastructure issues that affect content retrieval

sections.title: AI Crawler and Bot Access Diagnostics
checks: Observed access by identifiable AI-related crawlers
WAF, CDN, firewall, and rate-limit behavior
Differences between verified bots and spoofed user agents
Crawl access versus confirmed indexing or retrieval

sections.title: Reviews and Customer Evidence
checks: Consistency of product and service descriptions

sections.title: Digital PR and Citation Acquisition Opportunities
checks: Publications relevant to the target audience
Existing coverage that could be updated
Success criteria based on verified outcomes rather than outreach volume

sections.title: Brand Information Consistency Across the Web
checks: Conflicting descriptions with source URLs and timestamps

sections.title: Visibility Metrics and Definitions
checks: Brand mention rate (eligible mentions ÷ eligible tested)
Citation rate (eligible brand citations ÷ eligible tested)
Citation share (brand citations ÷ all citations in benchmark)
Share of mentions (brand mentions ÷ all brand mentions in benchmark)
Source diversity (distinct cited URLs and domains)
Brand accuracy (correct material claims ÷ evaluated claims)
Competitor overlap (query clusters with shared appearances)
AI referral sessions (attributed visits from AI referrers)

sections.title: Cross-Engine and Cross-Query Analysis
checks: Results for branded versus non-branded prompts

sections.title: Statistical Confidence and Benchmark Reliability
checks: Number of tested prompts and runs
Rules for comparing periods and competitors

sections.title: AI Referral Traffic and Conversion Attribution
checks: Landing pages receiving AI referral traffic
Lead, trial, and purchase outcomes where measured
Direct and untracked visits that cannot be reliably attributed

sections.title: GEO-to-Revenue Intelligence
checks: High-intent query clusters aligned with business goals
Qualified leads associated with AI referrals
Conversion quality compared with other channels
Customer acquisition outcomes where data supports them
Cost of content and source development
Incremental impact only when a credible measurement design exists

sections.title: GEO Findings and Evidence Ledger
checks: Finding ID and affected URL, query, engine, or source
Source URL or raw response reference

sections.title: AI referral analytics and attribution limitations
